parsed.post: Warmup 0.0 at depth12 regressed hard (0.9938→1.0260), discarding — third agent (after 3 and 9) to confirm removing warmup hurts. Next: WARMUP_RATIO 0.05→0.10 per agent-3's depth-8 sweep where 0.10 beat 0.05. Skipping AR-64: peak VRAM 8184MB looks pinned at an 8GB cap, so width probes would likely OOM; warmup is my safest final lever.
